g.text: 1 Hypoglycaemia (feed/sugar NOW — drowsy? test + treat) · 2 Hypothermia (warm: skin, blankets,
hat — cold kills quietly) · 3 Dehydration (ReSoMal SLOWLY — standard IV overloads!) · 4 Electrolytes
(K+/Mg — ReSoMal + food, NO iron yet!) · 5 Infection (assume + treat: antibiotics per protocol,
malaria, TB/HIV hunt — fever often ABSENT!) · 6 Micros (A, zinc, folate, multivit — iron LATER).
7 Cautious feeds (F75 small-frequent — stabilise, NOT fatten) · 8 Catch-up (F100/RUTF
generous — appetite returns = recovering!) · 9 Love + play (tender care, mother present, toys,
stimulation — brains rebuild with bodies) · 10 Prepare discharge (mother trained: feeds,
hygiene, vaccines, follow-up dated — OTP/RUTF + reviews till recovered).
KILLERS OF SAM CARE: IV fluids fast (heart failure!) · iron early (feeds infection — wait!) ·
high-protein feasts day 1 (re-feed — M05/GER!) · missed hypothermia/hypoglycaemia (check
ROUTINELY!) · mother excluded (she feeds, warms, watches — partner, never visitor).
OTP (outpatient): appetite test passes (eats RUTF eagerly!) + alert + no oedema+++ / danger →
RUTF home + antibiotics + weekly review (weight, appetite, illness) → graduate per protocol.
MAM: counsel + fortify + follow + SFP where available — catch BEFORE SAM.
DISCHARGE: eating family foods + gaining + mother confident + vaccines/deworm done + review
dated + CHPS linked. Document feeds + weights + steps daily (PRO-I M5); debrief deaths
(audit each — PRO-II M4: what failed? oedema missed? fluids fast? cold unwarmed?).
Mothers: praise + teach + feed WITH (demo enriched koko — M03!) — blame starves return;
